I2.quote: The ZIF-templated carbons are prepared via liquid impregnation of furfuryl alcohol (FA) into the pores of the ZIF followed by polymerization of the FA and finally carbonization at 900–1100 °C. The ZIF framework is effectively removed during the carbonization step.
